title: Risk Factors for Acquired Cardiovascular Disease in Adults With Congenital Heart Disease
brief_summary: This research study is to determine the risk factors for acquired heart disease, in adults with congenital heart disease. This knowledge is important to develop and target ways to prevent or delay the onset of acquired heart disease in adults with congenital heart disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or Female over 18 years of age
* Moderate or Complex Congenital Heart Disease
* Willingness to Consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Surgery within 6 months
* Unrepaired cyanotic heart disease
* Patients with Eisenmenger Syndrome physiology
study_population: Adults with Moderate or Complex Congenital Heart Disease
